title: Reforged Librarium Canonical Architecture Decisions for Codex

decisions.decision: The Librarium is the canonical source of truth.
decisions.implication: Runtime, server, editor, AI worlds, documentation, validation, and generated data consume the Librarium rather than inventing rules.

decisions.decision: /Data is no longer the master source once the Librarium compiler is active.
decisions.implication: /Data becomes generated RuntimeData compiled from Librarium knowledge records and world overlays.

decisions.decision: Every knowledge record and relationship carries evidence state, confidence, provenance, and validation history.
Formula records are stored as knowledge records with inputs, outputs, dependencies, evidence, and exact-equation status.
decisions.implication: Do not hardcode or promote exact classic equations without source reconciliation.
Classic Base + Reforged/Custom/AI/Test/Live overlay = running world. Custom/AI changes do not corrupt Classic canon.

decisions.decision: Codex should update the repository by preserving cumulative milestone structure and adding generated artifacts, not deleting evidence.
decisions.implication: All future patches must keep provenance and confidence.

next_for_codex: Treat MajorMUD-Reforged-Validation-0005 as the latest authoritative handoff.
Add Librarium compiler/export layer before treating /Data as final runtime input.
Keep canonical /Data unchanged unless generated from verified Librarium records.
Continue formula reconciliation using MMExplorer/MBBSEmu/reference/runtime traces.
